method: Titles copied from the awards section of each year's NDSS Symposium page. Paper recognitions only: distinguished paper awards and the 2019 honorable mentions; poster and artifact-evaluation awards are left out. Where the page's wording differs from the proceedings title (a typo, lost markup, or a title changed for the proceedings), the record also carries the proceedings title as `published_title`; the verify step checks the page wording and the corpus join uses the proceedings title.
